caption: The drawing depicts a four-poster canopy bed with tall, dark vertical posts at each corner. The canopy is covered with a light off-white or cream fabric, which drapes over the top and partially down the sides. The canopy fabric has a decorative edging featuring a wavy border with multi-colored patterns that include shades of red, blue, green, and yellow. The bedspread is light-colored, predominantly white or cream, and is adorned with elaborate, colorful floral designs in pink, blue, green, and purple. Matching floral-patterned curtains hang down from the canopy frame, fastened halfway down the posts. The base of the bed is covered with a white or light ruffled bed skirt that reaches the floor. The overall composition is rendered on a light background with minimal detail apart from the bed itself, which is centrally positioned and clearly detailed.
title: Bed
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
